description: This file contains the implementation of the BaseFacebook abstract class and the FacebookApiException class for interacting with the Facebook Platform API. It includes methods for handling OAuth, API requests, signed requests, user authentication, error handling, and configuration settings, as well as external dependency checks.

classes.name: FacebookApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class thrown when an API call returns an exception. It encapsulates the API error result and provides methods to retrieve error details and a string representation for debugging.

classes.name: BaseFacebook
classes.description: Abstract class providing core functionality for Facebook API integration, including OAuth flow, API request handling, signed request parsing, user authentication, URL generation, error handling, and persistent data management. It is designed to be subclassed with concrete implementations for persistent storage.

methods.name: setPersistentData
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in persistent storage for future retrieval across requests.

methods.name: getPersistentData
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with a key from persistent storage; returns default if not found.

methods.name: clearPersistentData
methods.description: Removes data associated with a key from persistent storage.
